correctness.rationale: For four equal strengths and exact geometric spacing, pairing the translates of sech gives the rational function of z=cosh(s). For s>0 its derivative has the sign of the cubic Q on v>4/(h−3). The independently checked curvature and discriminant factors have exactly one zero each for h>3, by the stated translation and Descartes/sign arguments. At h=10 three alternating sign brackets put all three roots inside the physical domain; continuity, nonzero leading coefficient and no boundary crossing extend this to h>h2. At h1 the simple boundary root gives a negative quartic term at the center; at h2 the interior double root creates a shoulder on each side without adding a strict maximum. These facts yield the stated inclusive endpoints and nondegeneracy away from the thresholds. The remote translates vanish in local coordinates around a component center; around a midpoint the scaled loss and its first two derivatives approach those of 2 cosh(y). This supports the claimed limiting locations and heights. No experimental resolving power follows.
residual_risks: The finite symbolic and numerical checks corroborate identities, not the parameter-uniform root argument by themselves.
